name: skill_icons
prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Make ONE coherent nine-icon game UI kit, arranged in an exact regular 3 by 3 grid, equal square cells and generous transparent gutters. Genuine alpha transparency outside each circular icon. The attached image is a STYLE REFERENCE only; do not copy its layout. Each icon will be reduced to 64x64 pixels for a Chinese wuxia ARPG. Ink-black #15121A circular face, thin hard pixel rim, simple bold 16-bit pixel symbols, each interior uses two main colors plus the rim. No antialiasing, blur, gradient, gloss or elaborate filigree. No letters, text, numbers, labels, cooldown shading, countdown arcs, disabled states or panels. All nine icons MUST be in their clean normal available state, full circles entirely visible and centered in their own cells. Row 1 gold #FFD24A rims and gold-white #FFF3C4 symbols: (1) a martial artist fist imprint, (2) a clear bell-shaped protective dome, (3) an open palm print. Row 2 purple #9B4DFF rims: (4) a purple palm plus small green sand grains, (5) one falling poison-green liquid drop, (6) a purple eye with a green central pupil. Row 3 gold-white #FFF3C4 rims: (7) a cloud with one footprint, (8) a healing open palm with a small warm-white light, (9) one severed rope with two separated frayed ends. Exactly nine circular icons, no additional symbols outside them. The graphic style should match the approved thin-gold black UI and the icons of the reference. Canvas square, preferably 960x960, each icon occupies about 70 percent of its cell so neighboring icons never touch.

name: button_icons
prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE small three-icon desktop/mobile action-button kit for the same Chinese wuxia pixel ARPG as the attached STYLE REFERENCE. Exactly three separate circular icons in a single horizontal row, each centered in an equal square cell, entire circles visible, large transparent gutters between. Genuine transparent alpha outside the icons. Native target each 64x64, large hard-edged pixel clusters, at most two interior colors plus the rim, clean dark #15121A circular faces. Icon 1: ordinary ATTACK, a plain diagonal Chinese wooden staff, gold rim #FFD24A and warm-white marks. Icon 2: DODGE, a single footprint with two short afterimage lines, pale white #FFF3C4 rim. Icon 3: TALK, a simple white empty speech bubble with a small tail, pale white rim, no dots or letters inside. Keep all three clean normal available state; no cooldown, text, numbers, characters, scenery, panel, logo, watermark, fake transparency checkerboard, glow or smooth gradients. Match the restrained native pixel graphic style of the reference. Landscape 3:1 canvas, preferably 960x320. Each icon occupies about 70 percent of its equal cell.

name: faction_final
prompt: Edit the attached two-character menu illustration. Preserve the two separate full bodies, their scale, pixel style, upper-left lighting and left/right clothing palettes. Make these precise corrections from the approved decisions: LEFT player's head must be an ordinary young Chinese man's tied-up dark hair with a plain cloth headband, no longer bald. No jade crown, hairpin, medicine case, apron or other origin-specific object. RIGHT must represent the same ordinary young man in the black-purple-green faction outfit, and hold ONE plain Chinese single-edged dao saber: broad-backed blade, cloth-wrapped handle, definitively not a katana or samurai weapon. Keep a calm standing pose and each full body and weapon fully inside its own half of the image. Simplify the elaborate robe patterns to restrained dark-purple accents. Remove all colored auras, background illumination and soft surrounding glows; only the two fully clothed figures on true transparent alpha, no floor or cast shadow. Render hard-edged low-resolution 16-bit pixel art with broad flat blocks and two shade levels, no gradients, max 16 colors per figure. No text, labels, watermarks, extra people or scene. Landscape 3:2 illustration strip, one figure per equal half.

name: jingxin_portraits
prompt: Create ONE two-expression dialogue portrait strip for Jingxin, an original Chinese wuxia companion. The reference supplies only the rustic monk palette and pixel art direction; Jingxin is a different person. Exactly TWO separate head-and-shoulders portraits side by side in equal square cells, generous transparent gutters, identical character identity in both. Jingxin is SEVENTEEN years old: a slender adolescent monk close to adult proportions, not a child, with a shaved bald head without ritual scars, a narrow youthful face, earnest eyebrows, worn brownish-red robe #8C3B2E, simple small dark wooden prayer beads at the collar. LEFT expression normal: anxious, resolute and stubborn, looking toward the player. RIGHT expression sad: gaze lowered, brow tightened, restrained grief after seeing a blood letter, no blood or wounds or cartoon crying. Three-quarter turned face, shoulders included, upper-left lighting. Design each portrait for native 96x96 pixels, serious restrained 16-bit pixel art, max 16 colors per portrait, 1 native-pixel dark outline, hard flat two-step shading, no smooth gradients, no anime eyes, no chibi. On actual alpha transparency, no background, aura, glowing border, panels, scenery, objects, letters, text, labels or watermark. Entire head and shoulders inside each square cell. Landscape 2:1 strip.

name: xuancheng_portraits
prompt: Create ONE two-expression dialogue portrait strip for Xuancheng, a tired adult renegade monk and martial instructor in an original Chinese wuxia game. The reference supplies only rustic pixel art palette/style, not his identity. Exactly TWO separate head-and-shoulders portraits side by side in equal square cells with transparent gutters, identical man in both. Tall thin mature Chinese man, angular tired face, short dark stubbly hair growing back, weary eyes, old brownish-red monk robe #8C3B2E under a plain ink-black #15121A sleeveless overcoat with restrained dark purple trim. Human, dignified, not demonic, no green face, no fangs, no skulls, no wounds. LEFT expression cold: guarded, stern mouth, tells the visitor to go back. RIGHT expression smile: a very slight tired approving smile after yielding, warm but restrained, no big grin. Three-quarter face turned toward the player, shoulders visible, upper-left lighting. Native target 96x96 per portrait, hard pixel clusters, 16-bit sprite aesthetic, max 16 colors per portrait, one-pixel dark-tone outline, flat two-step shading. Genuine transparent alpha background; no soft glows, panels, scenery, letters, text, labels, watermark or extra people. Landscape 2:1 strip.

name: combo_freeze
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a single full-screen cooperative attack freeze-frame effect for an original Chinese wuxia pixel-art action RPG. Landscape 16:9, target native 960x540. The entire frame is a dramatic FLAT gold-white burst #FFF3C4 and qi gold #FFD24A, with exactly TWO solid ink-black #15121A silhouettes in the center, one Chinese fighter lunging and sweeping a LONG WOODEN STAFF horizontally, the other fighter striking forward with an OPEN PALM. Readable intersecting diagonal action composition, clear separation of both human silhouettes, flowing simple Chinese martial robes, no chibi proportions, no swords or Japanese elements. Only these three colors, hard angular square pixel shapes, a few short radial speed lines, no gradients, no soft glow, no photographic textures or 3D. Intended as a very brief single flash frame, no long animation. No text, numbers, symbols, logo, UI, watermark or scenery. No extra people.
